pull_document_dialog.title: Tarik Dokumen Referensi (MRO / RO / PO)
pull_document_dialog.multi_select_rule: User can select full document or individual line-items with Outstanding Qty > 0

document_lifecycle_traceability.traceability_visualization: Use horizontal step timeline with clickable node popovers showing document number, timestamp, executor name, status, and linked target documents.

shadcn_overrides.dropdown_menu: Must NEVER have transparent background. Apply 'bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-md border border-border z-50'
shadcn_overrides.tab_list: Override h-9 to h-auto p-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg border
shadcn_overrides.table: Must include sticky headers for long tables and zebra striping option for fast scanning
shadcn_overrides.date_picker: Use Shadcn Calendar component inside Popover (DO NOT use native HTML <input type='date'>)
shadcn_overrides.toast: Use Sonner toast notifications with data-testid='toast-message'

stock_control_modules.warehouse_transfer: Transfer stok antar gudang dengan verifikasi pengirim & penerima
stock_control_modules.inter_warehouse_loan: Pinjam & Pengembalian barang antar gudang / proyek dengan tanggal jatuh tempo
stock_control_modules.stock_adjustment: Penyesuaian stok manual dengan alasan (Hilang, Rusak, Selisih Opname)
stock_control_modules.stock_opname: Fitur Cek Fisik Stok berkala dengan perbandingan Sistem vs Fisik & Auto Adjustment

print_designer_and_pdf.features: Preview mode, custom company logo header, signatures block for Creator/Checker/Approver, QR Code verification containing verification hash + doc ID
print_designer_and_pdf.print_styles: @media print { body { bg: white; } .no-print { display: none; } }

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates 'AI slop'. Avoid this by designing crisp, data-dense, enterprise-grade UIs.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as heavy full-screen gradients.
Create depth through subtle 1px crisp borders (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800) and layered card structures.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. 'transition: all'). Always apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors duration-150' or 'transition-opacity'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }). Left-align reading flows for high readability.
Every interaction needs micro-interactions: hover highlights on table rows, subtle scale on button presses, clear active focus rings.
Cramped designs look cheap. Use balanced padding (p-4 to p-6) inside data cards.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='create-mro-button', data-testid='tarik-ro-select-all').
Header and dropdown menus MUST NOT have pure transparent backgrounds; use backdrop-blur and opaque elevated surfaces.
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user-facing text uses proper Bahasa Indonesia terms (Pengajuan Material, Surat Jalan, Supplier, Stock Opname, Kartu Stok).
All currency figures must be formatted as Indonesian Rupiah (e.g., Rp 12.500.000).
Ensure document status badges use consistent color coding across MRO, RO, PO, DO, and MI.
Implement the 'Tarik Dokumen' modal logic allowing multi-select of pending line-items with auto-calculation of outstanding quantities.
Provide search & filtering on all tables including global search in top navigation.
Include Audit Trail tab or timeline for document history and approval approvals.
